people.name: Egypt

translations.web: Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength. Put and Libya were her helpers.
translations.bsb: Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength; Put and Libya were her allies.
translations.kjv: Ethiopia and Egypt were her strength, and it was infinite; Put and Lubim were thy helpers.
